notes:
Lead: SMB inbound via self-serve; trial credits used. POC goal: replace heuristic bot with LLM chat that can call internal tools (order lookup, refund-init). Primary friction area: streaming + structured output (JSON mode) + function/tool-calling.

Observed behaviors and customer quotes:
- 'Most of the time it works but every few responses the client chokes with JSON parse error.'
- When streaming large tool payloads the client receives partial JSON frames (e.g. '{\"order\": {\"id\": "1234' then next chunk '", \"status\": "shipped"}}') — their parser isn't reassembling correctly.
- Function/schema problems: their frontend sends function definitions with name 'getOrderDetails' but the model returns 'get_order_details' (snake_case vs camelCase mismatch). The customer: 'we expected the function to be called but it never was; model returned text instead.'
- Also saw examples where model emits extraneous commentary before the JSON block (\"Here's what I found:\n{...}\") — breaks strict JSON mode.

What we've done so far:
- SE session to verify request payloads and function schema; recommended canonicalization of function names and explicit schema in request.
- Sent example client-side reassembly approach (buffer chunks until closing brace with bracket counting) and suggested use of Redwood streaming-delimited events if available.
- Opened INF-4321 for eng to check server-side chunk boundaries and whether partial tokens are escaped.
- Provided link to hosted API quickstart and streaming best-practices (drive folder).

Customer constraints/priorities:
- Wants hosted API (public cloud) — self-serve is preferred. No immediate need for Private or Dedicated.
- Low tolerance for failed parses in production; wants deterministic function invocation for tools (order/refund).
- Cost sensitive but willing to move to committed plan if POC stable.

Immediate next actions (agreed):
- Jordan: send triage KB (streaming JSON reassembly patterns, recommended client parsers) by 2026-03-11.
- Priya (SE): schedule 1-hr office-hours window with eng on 2026-03-15 to reproduce chunking with their sample logs. Invite link + Fireflies.
- Customer: implement quick client-side buffer fix (prototype provided) and re-test; report success/failure within 72 hours.

Open questions for engineering:
- Are we guaranteeing that streaming frames will not split within a UTF-8 multibyte sequence or within an escape sequence?
- Can the model be instructed to output only the JSON object (strict json_mode) and suppress any narrated text? If so, what exact request flags are recommended?
- Function name matching policy: do we support case-insensitive matching or do customers need exact names?

Notes for sales/AE: POC sensitive to fast resolution. If we can provide a short KB + live triage window and client buffer guidance, conversion likelihood increases. Customer quote: 'If we can get consistent function calls it's a no-brainer to move to paid.'
